## 6.3 Downloading and preparing climate credit data

```{r step-008}
#| eval: false
ngfs_database <- "IXSE_NGFS_PHASE_5_SHORT_TERM"
ngfs_auth_url <- "https://api.manager.ece.iiasa.ac.at/legacy"
ngfs_base_url <- "https://db1.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs-phase-5-short-term-api/rest/v2.1"

ngfs_get_guest_token <- function(max_tries = 5, wait_seconds = 1) {
  token_url <- paste0(ngfs_auth_url, "/anonym/", ngfs_database)

  for (try_id in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    response <- try(
      httr::GET(
        token_url,
        query = list(algorithm = "HS256"),
        httr::timeout(30)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    if (!inherits(response, "try-error") &&
        httr::status_code(response) == 200) {
      token <- httr::content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      token <- gsub('^"|"$', "", token)

      if (nzchar(token)) {
        return(token)
      }
    }

    Sys.sleep(wait_seconds)
  }

  stop("The NGFS guest token could not be obtained. Check the internet connection or the NGFS/IIASA service.")
}

ngfs_post_timeseries <- function(runs, regions, variables, years = integer()) {
  token <- ngfs_get_guest_token()

  request_body <- list(
    filters = list(
      runs = as.list(as.integer(runs)),
      regions = as.list(regions),
      variables = as.list(variables),
      units = list(),
      years = as.list(as.integer(years)),
      timeslices = list("Year")
    )
  )

  response <- httr::POST(
    paste0(ngfs_base_url, "/runs/bulk/ts"),
    httr::add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", token)),
    httr::content_type_json(),
    body = jsonlite::toJSON(request_body, auto_unbox = TRUE),
    encode = "raw",
    httr::timeout(120)
  )

  response_text <- httr::content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

  if (httr::status_code(response) != 200) {
    stop(response_text)
  }

  data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(response_text, flatten = TRUE)

  if (length(data) == 0) {
    stop("The NGFS query returned no observations. Check run names, regions, variables, or years.")
  }

  tibble::as_tibble(data)
}
```

An optional refresh must use a new destination. Sourcing the helper only defines
functions; the explicit download call requires internet access and the `httr`
and `jsonlite` packages. Both responses are validated before any files are
written. Existing destinations are refused, and the frozen `data/climate/`
inputs remain the default for this chapter.

```{r step-009}

source("chapters/06-climate-credit-risk/helpers/download-data.R")
download_ngfs_data(destination = "tmp/ngfs-refresh")
```

### Reshaping the raw data for credit calculations

```{r step-017}
scenario_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  scenario = c("DIRE", "HWTP", "SWUC"),
  scenario_label = c(
    "Diverging Realities",
    "Highway to Paris",
    "Sudden Wake-up Call"
  )
)

source("chapters/06-climate-credit-risk/helpers/validation.R")
climate_years <- 2022:2030
climate_scenarios <- c("DIRE", "HWTP", "SWUC")
validate_climate_inputs(
  ngfs_raw, portfolio, climate_scenarios, climate_years, metric_names
)

climate_credit <- ngfs_raw |>
  tidyr::separate(
    variable,
    into = c("metric", "ngfs_sector"),
    sep = "\\|",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  inner_join(portfolio, by = "ngfs_sector") |>
  inner_join(scenario_lookup, by = "scenario") |>
  select(
    scenario,
    scenario_label,
    year,
    portfolio_sector,
    ngfs_sector,
    ead,
    recovery,
    metric,
    value
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  mutate(
    baseline_pd = baseline_pd / 100,
    pd_adjustment = pd_adjustment / 100,
    climate_pd = pmin(baseline_pd + pd_adjustment, 1),
    corporate_bond_spread_adjustment =
      corporate_bond_spread_adjustment / 100,
    corporate_bond_price_rel_adjustment =
      corporate_bond_price_rel_adjustment / 100,
    wacc_adjustment = wacc_adjustment / 100,
    lgd = 1 - recovery
  )
```

### Verifying complete portfolio coverage

Every requested scenario-year must retain every sector and the full exposure.
Missing mappings, duplicate inputs and invalid PDs stop the calculation for review.

```{r climate-joined-coverage}
climate_coverage <- validate_climate_portfolio(

)
c(scenario_year_groups = nrow(climate_coverage),
  minimum_EAD = min(climate_coverage$ead),
  maximum_EAD = max(climate_coverage$ead))
```

## 6.4 Physical risk is local

```{r step-020}
daps_runs <- c(
  DAPS_AFR_R = 68,
  DAPS_ASIA = 69,
  DAPS_EUR = 70,
  DAPS_NAM = 71,
  DAPS_OCE = 72,
  DAPS_SAM = 73
)

daps_regions <- c(
  "Africa",
  "Asia",
  "Euro Area",
  "North America",
  "Oceania",
  "South America"
)

daps_region_map <- tibble::tibble(
  scenario = names(daps_runs),
  region = daps_regions
)

daps_variables <- as.vector(
  outer(
    "pd_adjustment",
    c("Agriculture", "Coal", "Power Supply"),
    paste,
    sep = "|"
  )
)

daps_raw <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path("data", "climate", "ngfs_climacred_daps_raw.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

daps_pd <- daps_raw |>
  tidyr::separate(
    variable,
    into = c("metric", "ngfs_sector"),
    sep = "\\|",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  inner_join(daps_region_map, by = c("scenario", "region")) |>
  mutate(
    pd_adjustment = value / 100,
    region_label = case_when(
      scenario == "DAPS_AFR_R" ~ "Africa",
      scenario == "DAPS_ASIA" ~ "Asia",
      scenario == "DAPS_EUR" ~ "Euro Area",
      scenario == "DAPS_NAM" ~ "North America",
      scenario == "DAPS_OCE" ~ "Oceania",
      scenario == "DAPS_SAM" ~ "South America",
      TRUE ~ region
    )
  )

daps_summary <- daps_pd |>
  group_by(region_label, ngfs_sector) |>
  summarise(
    max_pd_adjustment = max(pd_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_fig_climate_physical_risk_local <- ggplot(daps_summary, aes(x = max_pd_adjustment * 100, y = reorder(region_label, max_pd_adjustment),
    fill = ngfs_sector)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65)
```

## 6.5 Expected loss with climate-adjusted PDs

```{r step-024}
pv_expected_loss <- function(pd_vector, ead, recovery, discount_rate) {
  h <- pmin(pmax(pd_vector, 0), 1)
  survival_start <- c(1, cumprod(1 - h)[-length(h)])
  marginal_pd <- survival_start * h
  discount <- 1 / (1 + discount_rate)^seq_along(h)

  sum(ead * (1 - recovery) * marginal_pd * discount)
}

risk_free_rate <- 0.04

horizon_loss <- climate_credit |>
  filter(year %in% horizon_years) |>
  arrange(scenario, portfolio_sector, year) |>
  group_by(
    scenario,
    scenario_label,
    portfolio_sector,
    ngfs_sector,
    ead,
    recovery
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pv_el_baseline = pv_expected_loss(
      baseline_pd,
      first(ead),
      first(recovery),
      risk_free_rate
    ),
    pv_el_climate = pv_expected_loss(
      climate_pd,
      first(ead),
      first(recovery),
      risk_free_rate
    ),
    incremental_pv_el = pv_el_climate - pv_el_baseline,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

portfolio_horizon_loss <- horizon_loss |>
  group_by(scenario_label) |>
  summarise(
    baseline_pv_el = sum(pv_el_baseline),
    climate_pv_el = sum(pv_el_climate),
    incremental_pv_el = sum(incremental_pv_el),
    increase = climate_pv_el / baseline_pv_el - 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

largest_scenario_increase <- portfolio_horizon_loss |>
  arrange(desc(incremental_pv_el)) |>
  slice(1)

top_sector_increase <- horizon_loss |>
  arrange(desc(incremental_pv_el)) |>
  slice(1)

coal_hwtp_path <- climate_credit |>
  filter(
    scenario == "HWTP",
    portfolio_sector == "Coal",
    year %in% horizon_years
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

coal_hwtp_survival_start <- c(
  1,
  cumprod(1 - coal_hwtp_path$climate_pd)[-length(coal_hwtp_path$climate_pd)]
)

coal_hwtp_marginal_pd <- coal_hwtp_survival_start * coal_hwtp_path$climate_pd

coal_hwtp_discount <- 1 / (1 + risk_free_rate)^seq_along(coal_hwtp_path$year)

coal_hwtp_lgd <- 1 - coal_hwtp_path$recovery

coal_hwtp_pv_el <- coal_hwtp_path$ead *
  coal_hwtp_lgd *
  coal_hwtp_marginal_pd *
  coal_hwtp_discount
```

```{r step-025}
coal_hwtp_el_steps <- data.frame(
  Year = coal_hwtp_path$year,
  `Climate PD` = fmt_pct(coal_hwtp_path$climate_pd, 2),
  `Survival at start` = fmt_pct(coal_hwtp_survival_start, 2),
  `Marginal PD` = fmt_pct(coal_hwtp_marginal_pd, 2),
  EAD = fmt_usd_m(coal_hwtp_path$ead),
  LGD = fmt_pct(coal_hwtp_lgd, 1),
  `Discount factor` = fmt_num(coal_hwtp_discount, 4),
  `PV expected loss` = fmt_usd_m(coal_hwtp_pv_el)
)
```

## 6.8 Portfolio loss simulation

### What one sector default represents

```{r step-042}
simulate_climate_losses <- function(pd_baseline,
                                    pd_climate,
                                    ead,
                                    recovery,
                                    rho = 0.25,
                                    n_sims = 50000,
                                    seed = 202606) {
  set.seed(seed)

  n_sectors <- length(pd_baseline)
  common_factor <- rnorm(n_sims)
  idiosyncratic <- matrix(
    rnorm(n_sims * n_sectors),
    nrow = n_sims,
    ncol = n_sectors
  )

  credit_score <- sqrt(rho) * common_factor +
    sqrt(1 - rho) * idiosyncratic

  loss_given_default <- ead * (1 - recovery)

  baseline_defaults <- sweep(
    credit_score,
    2,
    qnorm(pd_baseline),
    "<"
  )

  climate_defaults <- sweep(
    credit_score,
    2,
    qnorm(pd_climate),
    "<"
  )

  losses <- tibble::tibble(
    case = rep(c("Baseline", "Climate-adjusted"), each = n_sims),
    loss = c(
      as.numeric(baseline_defaults %*% loss_given_default),
      as.numeric(climate_defaults %*% loss_given_default)
    )
  )

  list(
    losses = losses,
    credit_score = credit_score,
    baseline_defaults = baseline_defaults,
    climate_defaults = climate_defaults
  )
}

simulation_input <- climate_credit |>
  filter(
    year == 2030,
    scenario == "HWTP"
  ) |>
  arrange(portfolio_sector)

climate_simulation <- simulate_climate_losses(
  pd_baseline = simulation_input$baseline_pd,
  pd_climate = simulation_input$climate_pd,
  ead = simulation_input$ead,
  recovery = simulation_input$recovery
)

simulated_losses <- climate_simulation$losses

loss_summary <- simulated_losses |>
  group_by(case) |>
  summarise(
    mean_loss = mean(loss),
    var_95 = as.numeric(quantile(loss, 0.95, type = 1)),
    es_95 = expected_shortfall(loss, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

loss_lift <- loss_summary |>
  mutate(case_id = if_else(case == "Baseline", "baseline", "climate")) |>
  select(case_id, mean_loss, var_95, es_95) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = case_id,
    values_from = c(mean_loss, var_95, es_95)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mean_increase = mean_loss_climate - mean_loss_baseline,
    var_increase = var_95_climate - var_95_baseline,
    es_increase = es_95_climate - es_95_baseline
  )
```

### Table 6.13 {#result-table-6-13}

```{r table-6-13}
loss_summary |>
  transmute(
    Case = case,
    `Mean loss` = fmt_usd_m(mean_loss),
    `95% VaR` = fmt_usd_m(var_95),
    `95% expected shortfall` = fmt_usd_m(es_95)
  ) |>
  companion_kable(
    caption = "One-year simulated portfolio loss in 2030 under Highway to Paris."
  )
```

### From one simulated row to a monetary loss

```{r step-044}
base_events <- climate_simulation$baseline_defaults
climate_events <- climate_simulation$climate_defaults
climate_trace_row <- which(
  rowSums(base_events) == 1 & rowSums(climate_events) == 2 &
  rowSums(base_events & !climate_events) == 0
)[1]
climate_trace_sectors <- which(climate_events[climate_trace_row, ])
climate_trace <- simulation_input[climate_trace_sectors, ] |>
  mutate(
    score = climate_simulation$credit_score[
      climate_trace_row, climate_trace_sectors
    ],
    baseline_cutoff = qnorm(baseline_pd),
    climate_cutoff = qnorm(climate_pd),
    baseline_loss = ead * lgd * base_events[
      climate_trace_row, climate_trace_sectors
    ],
    climate_loss = ead * lgd
  )
```

### Table 6.14 {#result-table-6-14}

```{r table-6-14}
climate_trace |>
  transmute(
    Sector = portfolio_sector,
    `Credit score` = fmt_num(score, 4),
    `Baseline cutoff` = fmt_num(baseline_cutoff, 4),
    `Climate cutoff` = fmt_num(climate_cutoff, 4)
  ) |>
  companion_kable(caption = "Credit scores and default cutoffs for two sectors in one simulated row.")
```
